note: Front of pack (180g) and the nutrition panel only. The ingredient and allergen block is on a flap that was not photographed — this is a milk chocolate bar and no allergen statement of any kind was read, so nothing is recorded for it. Serving size printed '25g (approx. 4 squares)'. Front also carries 'SUPPORTING SUSTAINABLY SOURCED COCOA'. Allergens, ingredients, storage and origin read from Cadbury's own NZ product page 2026-09-06 (the unphotographed flap), NOT from the photograph. Matched on brand, product, variant and 180 g pack, and corroborated by the panel that WAS photographed: the page's serving size 25 g and 7.2 servings per pack are the same figures. The declared MAY CONTAIN includes PEANUTS and TREE NUTS. The page's own nutrition figures differ from the photographed panel by a rounding step (2100 vs 2090 kJ per 100 g, sodium 130 vs 129 mg); the panel above is the pack's own and has NOT been reconciled against the website.
